In /Users/marcelspatz/NUDIMMUD/backend/src, find and read all code related to NEURAL_FORGE polling and the MaxListeners memory leak.

Background: pm2 logs show this repeating error:
```
MaxListenersExceededWarning: Possible EventEmitter memory leak detected. 11 error listeners added to [TLSSocket]. MaxListeners is 10.
MaxListenersExceededWarning: Possible EventEmitter memory leak detected. 11 error listeners added to [Socket]. MaxListeners is 10.
```
And these error patterns:
```
⬡ NEURAL_FORGE :: CLOUD_OFFLINE (Request failed with status code 404)
⬡ NEURAL_FORGE_ATTEMPT_FAILED :: qwen-liberated:latest :: OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_qwen-liberated:latest
⬡ NEURAL_FORGE_ATTEMPT_FAILED :: claude-3-5-sonnet-liberated :: 400 credit balance too low
```

Find:
1. The NEURAL_FORGE service file(s) — full path and all polling/retry logic
2. Where HTTP/HTTPS requests are made (axios, fetch, node http) and whether listeners are attached to sockets without being removed
3. Any setInterval/setTimeout polling loops
4. Any retry logic that creates new connections per attempt
5. The ping/health-check code (PING_STATUS logged every few seconds)

Report exact file paths, line numbers, and the specific patterns causing listener accumulation. Medium thoroughness.
